title: On Settling the matter in one afternoon
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：settle　|　正文 352 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 settle 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1989 the driver ① settled the matter in one afternoon on the same day, and every passenger in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the driver ② settles the matter in one afternoon before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ settle the matter in one afternoon at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ settled the matter in one afternoon before — a line in the timetable for February 1983 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Settling the matter in one afternoon on the same day, the driver said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ settle the newcomers in the north street before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Settle the newcomers in the north street at once and never mention it again.

By 1996 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the timetable, and a new passenger from the next station ⑧ settles the newcomers in the north street on the same day every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the platform, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ settled the matter in one afternoon again when nobody else would.

⑩ To settle the matter in one afternoon, my mother said in 2001, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the station remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the station forgets, somebody settles the matter in one afternoon before dawn again and somebody must settle the matter in one afternoon on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 解决（一般过去式 settled the matter in one afternoon：1989 年司机头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 解决（一般现在 settles the matter in one afternoon：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 解决（不定式 to settle the matter in one afternoon：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 解决（过去完成时 had settled the matter in one afternoon：1983 年二月的时刻表上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 解决（动名词 settling the matter in one afternoon 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 安顿（settle the newcomers in the north street：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去安顿把新来的人安顿在北街）
G. v. 安顿（settle the newcomers in the north street：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 解决（后段两处：新来的乘客照例 settles the newcomers in the north street，而母亲又一次 settled the matter in one afternoon）

answers.why: settle 意为“解决”，1989 年司机当天就解决一个下午把那件事了结，那是车站里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 settled。
settle 意为“解决”，自那以后司机天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 settles。
settle 意为“解决”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯解决一个下午把那件事了结”，此处为不定式 to settle the matter in one afternoon。
settle 意为“解决”，时刻表里 二月 那行字说明早在 1996 年之前就有人解决过，故用过去完成时 had settled。
settle 意为“解决”，司机说“解决一个下午把那件事了结这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 settling the matter in one afternoon 作主语。
settle 意为“安顿”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去安顿把新来的人安顿在北街”，should ever 之后用原形 settle the newcomers in the north street。
settle 意为“安顿”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻安顿把新来的人安顿在北街（settle the newcomers in the north street at once），以后再也不要提起。
settle 意为“解决”，新来的乘客每个日子都照例安顿把新来的人安顿在北街，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 settles。
settle 意为“解决”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就解决一个下午把那件事了结，用一般过去式 settled 叙述。
settle 意为“解决”，结尾那句是母亲 2001 年的话：要解决一个下午把那件事了结，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和车站记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 settle 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1989 the driver settled the matter in one afternoon on the same day, and nobody in the station forgot it.
Even now the driver settles the matter in one afternoon before dawn whenever the station asks.
Settling the matter in one afternoon on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever settle the newcomers in the north street before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new passenger from the next station settles the newcomers in the north street on the same day every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother settled the matter in one afternoon again, and the station remembered that half.
